_readme: Ready-written quote types for Mworx Group. One entry per kind of job; the app offers the ones whose application_type matches the project. Scope lines: a leading space marks a sub-item (the same convention as the quote form). Bracketed text is a placeholder to overwrite. Generate SQL with: node scripts/seed-quote-types.mjs

templates.name: DA — Residential (Class 1)

payment_plan.label: On issue of the floor plans
On issue of the remaining drawings
Prior to lodgement of the DA

items: Design and preparation of the layout plan to suit the brief and Council's controls
Meetings and modifications required to finalise the layout plan
Submission of the DA on the NSW Planning Portal
Drafting amendments and re-submissions to suit Council requests (where required)
Schedule of External Colours and Finishes
notes: Council and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client.
Consultant reports (survey, BASIX, structural, stormwater, arborist, geotechnical and the like) are excluded. We coordinate them and their fees are payable directly to the consultant.
A detail survey plan with contours to AHD, in DWG format, is to be provided by the client before design commences.
Construction Certificate documentation, Section 4.55 modifications and any submission after determination are not included and will be quoted separately.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine Council requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: DA — Commercial (Class 2–9)

payment_plan.label: On issue of the floor plans
On issue of the remaining drawings
Prior to lodgement of the DA

items: Design and preparation of the layout plan to suit the brief and the applicable planning controls
Meetings and modifications required to finalise the layout plan
Submission of the DA on the NSW Planning Portal
Drafting amendments and re-submissions to suit Council requests (where required)
Driveway / Ramp Grade Details (vehicular crossing design by others)
notes: Council and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client.
Consultant reports (survey, traffic, acoustic, BCA, access, fire safety, structural, stormwater and the like) are excluded. We coordinate them and their fees are payable directly to the consultant.
A detail survey plan with contours to AHD, in DWG format, is to be provided by the client before design commences.
No provision has been made for a Section 34 conference, Land and Environment Court proceedings or the lead-up to such events. This will be quoted separately.
Construction Certificate documentation, Section 4.55 modifications and any submission after determination are not included and will be quoted separately.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine Council requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: DA — Change of Use
items: Change of use to a [proposed use] at [address]
Site visit and measure up of the existing premises
Internal alterations to include the following:
Submission of the DA on the NSW Planning Portal
Responses to Council requests for information
notes: No additions to the existing building envelope and no external signage are included.
Any performance solution coordination and implementation will be charged at a rate of $330 per performance solution.

Council and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client. Consultant reports (BCA, access, fire safety, acoustic, traffic and the like) are excluded; we coordinate them and their fees are payable directly to the consultant.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine Council requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: CDC — Change of Use / Fit-out
items: Change of use to a [proposed use] at [address]
Internal alterations to include the following:
Reflected Ceiling Plan showing existing and proposed dry fire measures
Submission of the CDC application on the NSW Planning Portal
Submission of the PC appointment application on the NSW Planning Portal
notes: This fee excludes site visit and measure up of the premises; if required, it will be charged at $750.
Any performance solution coordination and implementation will be charged at a rate of $330 per performance solution.
Stairway section/detail is to be provided by others.
No additions to the existing building envelope and no external signage are included.

Certifier and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client. Consultant reports (fire safety, access, structural and the like) are excluded; we coordinate them and their fees are payable directly to the consultant.
Any amendments or re-submissions after the CDC has been issued will be quoted separately.

templates.name: CDC — New Work / Alterations & Additions

payment_plan.label: On issue of the floor plans
On issue of the remaining drawings
Prior to lodgement with the certifier

items: Complying Development Certificate for [proposed works] at [address]
Design and preparation of the layout plan to suit the brief and the Codes SEPP
Meetings and modifications required to finalise the layout plan
Coordination of the required consultants (until CDC determination)
Submission of the CDC application on the NSW Planning Portal
Drafting amendments and re-submissions to suit the certifier (where required)
Construction Details in plan and section (up to two)
Driveway / Ramp Grade Details (vehicular crossing design by others)
notes: No basements, swimming pools or freestanding structures are included.
A detail survey plan with contours to AHD, in DWG format, is to be provided by the client before design commences.

Certifier and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client. Consultant reports (survey, BASIX / Section J, structural, stormwater, fire safety, access and the like) are excluded; we coordinate them and their fees are payable directly to the consultant.
Any performance solution coordination and implementation will be charged at a rate of $330 per performance solution.
Any amendments or re-submissions after the CDC has been issued will be quoted separately.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine certifier requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: CC — Construction Certificate

payment_plan.label: On commencement of the CC documentation
Prior to submission to the certifier

items: Construction Certificate documentation and coordination for [DA number] at [address]
Meeting to discuss the consent and outline the process to obtain the CC
Drafting the changes required to meet the conditions of consent for CC issue
Schedule of external materials and finishes
Submission of the CC to the certifier
Drafting amendments and re-submissions to suit the certifier (where required)
notes: Any performance solution coordination and implementation will be charged at a rate of $330 per performance solution.
Any modification to the approved plans must be approved by the certifier. If a Section 4.55 modification is required, it will be quoted separately.
The client is to provide the DA consent, the approved plans in DWG and PDF format, and all consultant plans and reports that accompanied the DA.

Certifier fees are payable by the client. Consultant reports (structural, hydraulic, BASIX / Section J, fire safety, access and the like) are excluded; we coordinate them and their fees are payable directly to the consultant.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine certifier requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: BIC — Unauthorised Works

payment_plan.label: On finalisation of the as built plans

items: Building Information Certificate for the [structure / use] at [address]
As built plans identifying existing authorised and unauthorised works
Statement of works to accompany the application
Coordination of the required consultants (structural certification, fire safety and the like)
Lodge the Building Information Certificate (BIC) on the NSW Planning Portal
notes: Council fees are payable by the client. Consultant certification is excluded and payable directly to the consultant.
Where Council requires works to be removed, modified or added before the BIC can issue, the DA and/or CC documentation for those works will be quoted separately.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine Council requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: S4.55 — Modification of Consent

payment_plan.label: Prior to lodgement of the modification

items: Proposed modifications to include the following:
Statement of modification (addendum to the Statement of Environmental Effects)
Submission of the modification application on the NSW Planning Portal
Responses to Council requests for information
notes: Council and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client. Updates to consultant reports are excluded and payable directly to the consultant.
This fee assumes the approved drawings are available in CAD. Redrawing approved plans from PDF will be quoted separately.

The fee includes reasonable responses to routine Council requests relating to the documentation prepared by Mworx Group. Substantial amendments, additional documentation, redesign, additional site visits or work arising from matters not reasonably identifiable at the time of this quote will be treated as a variation.

templates.name: Drafting Only — Fixed Fee
items: Redrawing the plans based on the plans provided by the client (no measure up)
notes: No allowance for a measure up was made. Client to provide existing floor plans. If a site visit and measure up is required, it will be charged at $750.
This fee includes the production of the plans provided by the client. Any further amendments will be quoted and charged separately.
No lodgement, consultant coordination or compliance assessment is included.

templates.name: Hourly — Miscellaneous Work

items.description: Fixed fee for the first 10 hours of [description]
Hourly rate for every hour thereafter

notes: Hours are invoiced fortnightly with the total hours worked for that period. A detailed breakdown of a fortnight's time is available on request within 7 days of that invoice.
Work commences on payment of the fixed fee. Payment terms are 7 days from the invoice date.
Council, certifier and NSW Planning Portal fees are payable by the client. Consultant reports are excluded and payable directly to the consultant.
